title: Cross-stitch rainbow heart
subtitle: A heart filled with rainbow stripes on 14-count white Aida
excerpt: A large heart shape filled with six horizontal stripes in the classic rainbow sequence on 14-count white Aida. The design is approximately 70 by 65 stitches and finishes at around 12 by 11 cm. The white Aida background lets the colours read clearly, and no outlining is needed for a clean result.
sourceNotes: Original design. The six-stripe rainbow flag was designed by Gilbert Baker in 1978 (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet). The design is widely used as a symbol of LGBTQ+ inclusion.

content.text: The heart outline is defined by the cross-stitch fill itself; no back-stitch outline is needed. The six rainbow stripes fill the heart from top to bottom in equal bands. The counting is straightforward: work the top curved lobes of the heart first to establish the shape boundary, then fill downward in colour bands.

items.label: Thread
items.value: DMC 321 (red), 741 (medium tangerine), 972 (deep canary yellow), 703 (chartreuse green), 996 (medium electric blue), 553 (violet)

content.text: Mark the heart centre on the fabric.
The centre of the heart shape is slightly below the centre of the fabric because the upper lobes extend higher. Centre the horizontal midpoint only; allow extra fabric height above for the lobes.
Stitch the red band across the top of the heart.
Begin with the red (321) band. The top band follows the curved top edge of the heart; it will be fewer stitches wide at the sides of each lobe and widest in the middle of the heart.
Work each colour band downward in sequence.

Orange (741), yellow (972), green (703), blue (996), violet (553). Each band is approximately ten to eleven rows deep. The heart narrows to a point at the base; the final violet band tapers to a few stitches.
The bottom point of the heart should end in a single stitch of violet at the lowest row. Count from the chart to confirm the taper is correct before ending the thread.

Display in a 15 cm round hoop or frame in a 15 × 15 cm square mount. The white Aida background requires no additional stitching. A small 'Love is love' back-stitch addition below the heart is an optional extra.
